invariants.description: f_v equals the algebraic vagal law
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_v - ((f_ev_0 + f_ev_inf*np.exp((f_ab - f_ab_0)/k_ev))/(1 + np.exp((f_ab - f_ab_0)/k_ev)) + W_cv*f_apc - theta_v))) <= 1e-9*max(1.0, abs(f_ev_inf) + abs(W_cv*f_apc))

invariants.description: vagal activity is non-negative for non-negative afferent inputs

bc_sweep.rationale: f_ab covers the full baroreceptor output range (f_ab_min 2.52 to f_ab_max 47.78 spikes/s); f_apc 0-20 spikes/s covers chemoreceptor output up to K_stat; theta_v offset around the Ursino & Magosso -0.68.

baseline.reason: central integration block with no directly measurable counterpart in isolation (vagal firing is not measured against f_ab); verified against its exact algebraic law. Closed-loop validation (HR response) belongs to a network that uses it.
